[[Ahvha Sankii]] is a [[Ranger]] [[boss]] found on top of the frozen [[Miki Lake]], always accompanied by two [[Mountain Yeti]].

== Locations ==
* [[Shing Jea Island]]
** {{NPC location|Jaya Bluffs}} (on [[Miki Lake]])

== Skills ==
7 [[Beast Mastery]]
* {{skill icon|Primal Echoes}}
* {{skill icon|Snare}}
* {{skill icon|Viper's Nest}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Ahvha's Longbow]] ([[unique]])
* [[Bolt of Cloth]]
* [[Stolen Supplies]] 
* [[Tanned Hide Square]]
* [[Yeti Armguard]]

== Notes ==
* There are two mobs of [[Sensali Tengu]] to the north and west that are very near this boss.  The mobs often [[aggro]] and kill this boss even before you get to the area.
